description: Return the ordered procedure for where the agent is in the methodology loop. Supply `phase` (one of: kickoff, goal_brief, intent_doc, session_open, session_active, session_close, standup) and optional `facts` (e.g. a ticket id) to tailor the output. Returns { steps, reads_first, escalation_points, notes? } sourced from the bundled guides and conventions — the procedure half of advisor + validator. The server reads no files.

facts.description: Optional facts to weave into the procedure (e.g. ticket id, work dir).

phase.description: Which phase of the methodology loop the agent is in.

name: next_procedure
title: Get the procedure for a methodology phase
